_readme.what: Where the Google Sheet CMS lives. One published tab per entry. These are committed rather than kept as GitHub secrets on purpose: a published-to-web URL is public and read only, so it is not a secret and treating it like one would only make it harder to find when something breaks.
_readme.howToChange: File > Share > Publish to web in the sheet, expand Published content & settings, tick the tab, then read its gid out of the link the dialog gives you. The token is the same for every tab in one document.
_readme.publishing: Only rows with status set to approved are written to the site. Anything else, including a blank status, stays off. Note that the published CSV itself carries every row, drafts included, so nothing typed into this sheet should be treated as private.
